Here’s a breakdown of what entity["brand","Katie & Floyd",0] sells in terms of sales / marketing content (based on publicly available information). If you want, I can check for pricing, program details, and user reviews too.

---

### What they offer  
Katie & Floyd is a coaching / training brand focused on helping entrepreneurs, coaches, and product sellers create profitable offers, build sales funnels, and scale via paid ads and content. citeturn0search0turn0search7  
Here are some of their specific products / content bundles:

- **“Money Making Sales Page”**: A course that shows how to write a high-converting sales page, including AI prompts, templates, and a walkthrough of one that produced $118,828 in 30 days. citeturn0search1  
- **“Ads That Sell Digital & Physical Products on Autopilot”**: A paid-ads course aimed at selling both digital and physical products via evergreen ad funnels, targeting cold audiences, and minimal social posting. citeturn0search6  
- **“Make Your Audience Go Crazy”** (also called “Turn Your Content Into Money”): Content frameworks for converting followers or audiences into buyers — teaching how to write posts, emails, and other content that activate buying behaviour rather than just nurturing. citeturn0search11  
- Additional digital training offerings listed on their member-site include:  
  - Automated Leads With Instagram  
  - The Big Box of Sales Templates  
  - 30 Days of Done-For-You (DFY) Posts + Emails  
  - Irresistible Video Ads (30-second ads)  
  - $3K Cash Days (advanced scaling)  
  - Digital Course Course (create low-ticket courses)  
  - Get Paid to Grow Your List (list-building strategy)  
  - 5 Figures in Your Inbox – The Email Sales Course  
  - Crystal Clear Offer Bundle (messaging formula) citeturn0search7  

---

### The focus / promise  
- Their positioning emphasises *selling with less hustle*: no launches, no heavy free-live-webinar funnels, minimal social posting (or at least less dependency). For example: “No Sales Calls, No Livestreams, No Free Live Masterclasses.” citeturn0search11  
- They emphasise *sales psychology* and *automation / paid ads* as the lever to scale. Eg: “the Video Ad Formula That Makes Paid Ads Work in Just 30 Seconds Flat. Even if you’re not an ads expert (and your budget’s under $500).” citeturn0search6turn0search0  
- They target people who already have (or want to have) digital products, courses, coaching, or physical products and want to move them with ads, content frameworks and optimized sales pages. Eg: “Course Creators · Coaches · Service Providers · Agency Owners · E-Commerce · Physical products (soap, clothes etc).” citeturn0search11  

---

### Relevance to you  
Given your focus (med-spa, aesthetics, wellness business leaders), here’s how their content might apply (and possible fit/mismatch):

- **Fit**: If you are offering digital/online packages (e.g., wellness coaching, HRT programs, masterclasses) or high-value services with online funnels, the frameworks they teach (sales pages, paid ads, content conversion) could be beneficial.  
- **Consideration**: Their domain appears more oriented toward productised digital offers and maybe lower-ticket/bundled digital products rather than very-high-ticket in-person service businesses. You’d want to assess whether their methods translate well into the high-value service space of med-spa/injectables where leads, compliance, in-person conversions play a big role.  
- **Due Diligence**: It’s sensible to review student results, match their case studies to your niche, and ensure the strategies align with your audience’s buying behaviours (aesthetics, wellness clients are different than “buy an online course” clients).
